readings: Join fees to orders on fees.orderslink = orders.recordvault and orders to users on orders.userlink = users.userstamp, excluding fees without both matches. For each (orderslink, users.acctscope) pair, calculate AVG(feerate), ignoring NULL feerate values. Calculate the mean of these pair averages across all scopes, excluding NULL pair averages. Keep pairs whose average is strictly above that global mean, and calculate average minus global mean as the excess. Within each account scope, order the retained pairs by excess descending, breaking ties by orderslink ascending, and assign ROW_NUMBER. Return only rows numbered 1 through 3, showing orderslink, account scope, average fee rate, excess, and row number as the pair's rank, without rounding.

Join fees to orders on fees.orderslink = orders.recordvault and orders to users on orders.userlink = users.userstamp, excluding fees without both matches. For each (orderslink, users.acctscope) pair, calculate AVG(feerate), ignoring NULL feerate values. Calculate the mean of these pair averages across all scopes, excluding NULL pair averages. Keep pairs whose average is strictly above that global mean, and calculate average minus global mean as the excess. Within each account scope, assign RANK by excess descending, giving tied pairs the same rank and leaving gaps after ties. Return every pair with rank at most 3, including ties, showing orderslink, account scope, average fee rate, excess, and rank, without rounding.
queries:
WITH pair_averages AS (
    SELECT
        f.orderslink,
        u.acctscope,
        AVG(f.feerate) AS average_fee_rate
    FROM fees AS f
    JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
    JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
    GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
global_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_fee_rate) AS mean_fee_rate
    FROM pair_averages
),
ranked_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        p.orderslink,
        p.acctscope,
        p.average_fee_rate,
        p.average_fee_rate - g.mean_fee_rate AS excess,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.acctscope
            ORDER BY p.average_fee_rate - g.mean_fee_rate DESC, p.orderslink ASC
        ) AS pair_rank
    FROM pair_averages AS p
    CROSS JOIN global_mean AS g
    WHERE p.average_fee_rate > g.mean_fee_rate
)
SELECT orderslink, acctscope, average_fee_rate, excess, pair_rank
FROM ranked_pairs
WHERE pair_rank <= 3

WITH pair_averages AS (
    SELECT f.orderslink,
           u.acctscope,
           AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate
    FROM fees AS f
    JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
    JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
    GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
global_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_feerate
    FROM pair_averages
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT p.orderslink,
           p.acctscope,
           p.avg_feerate,
           p.avg_feerate - g.mean_feerate AS excess,
           RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY p.acctscope
               ORDER BY p.avg_feerate - g.mean_feerate DESC
           ) AS fee_rank
    FROM pair_averages AS p
    CROSS JOIN global_mean AS g
    WHERE p.avg_feerate > g.mean_feerate
)
SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, fee_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE fee_rank <= 3
